cardOverview.overviewText: SBM (State Bank of Mauritius) has partnered with Niyo Global to offer customers a seamless international banking experience. Through this collaboration, SBM users can access Niyo Global's services, including multi-currency accounts and easy cross-border transactions, enhancing their global payment capabilities with added convenience and security.
